headings.usage: H1, H2, H3 - large marketing text. CRITICAL: apply tracking-tighter

mono.usage: Agent logs, risk score numbers, developer/tech details, overlines, and terminal UI outputs.

visual_enhancers.noise_overlay: Implement a fixed pointer-events-none noise SVG overlay at 3% opacity over the entire app to give a cinematic grainy feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl and backdrop-saturate-150 with a 1px solid white/10 border for the header and floating cards.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.5)] on key agent nodes and primary CTAs.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. gap-8 or gap-12 for bento grids.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For the 'Services' and 'Interactive Demo' sections, use the Mode A Tetris grid. Mix col-span-2, col-span-4, and col-span-8 blocks. Never perfectly symmetrical.
grids_and_layouts.pipeline_layout: Horizontal on desktop, vertical on mobile. 5 nodes connected by SVG dashed lines.

component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary button: bg-transparent border border-[#00F0FF] text-[#00F0FF] hover:bg-[#00F0FF] hover:text-black hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.6)] transition-all duration-300.
component_instructions.cards: Flat background (bg-slate-900/50), 1px border-white/10, rounded-2xl. On hover, translate-y-[-4px] and border glows slightly cyan.
component_instructions.nav_bar: Sticky top, crystal glass effect (bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). DO NOT MAKE FULLY TRANSPARENT.

motion_and_interactions.hero_animation: Use Framer Motion to stagger in the H1, subtitle, and CTA. Add a floating animation to a 3D or abstract data background.
motion_and_interactions.pipeline_animation: Animate a small glowing 'data packet' (a div or SVG circle) along a path connecting the 5 agents: Intake -> Risk Scoring -> Root-Cause -> Prioritization -> Action. The Orchestrator sits above, receiving pulses.
motion_and_interactions.live_demo_widget: When a user clicks a department icon, show a 'loading/scanning' state with JetBrains Mono random characters changing rapidly for 1 second, then reveal the Risk Gauge (animating from 0 to 85%), Priority rank, and the plain language root-cause.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for Testimonials/Voice of the Community. Dark cards with subtle border, user avatars.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion whileInView to slide up and fade in sections (y: 40, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1).

sections_guidance.hero: H1 text-5xl md:text-7xl tracking-tighter. Use JetBrains Mono for a tech overline. Background should feature glowing blue/cyan abstract nodes. CTA: 'Initialize Demo'.
sections_guidance.agent_pipeline: Section title: 'The SLA Guardian Architecture'. Render 5 distinct nodes (boxes with lucide icons) arranged horizontally. 1: Intake. 2: Risk Scoring. 3: Root-Cause. 4: Prioritization. 5: Action. Add an 'Orchestrator' node above them connecting to all. Pulse animations along connection lines.
sections_guidance.live_demo_widget: Split layout. Left: Select department (lucide icons: Droplets (Water), Zap (Electricity), Trash2 (Sanitation), FileText (Permits), Activity (Healthcare), Landmark (Tax)). Right: A retro-futuristic terminal UI showing Risk Score (circular gauge or progress bar colored Red for Critical, Yellow for Watch), Priority Rank, and a Typewriter effect for the Root Cause explanation.
sections_guidance.problem_solution: Use contrasting colors or split-screen. 'The Problem: Bottlenecks go unnoticed until SLAs breach.' vs 'The Solution: Predictive agentic foresight.'
sections_guidance.features_bento: Bento grid of services. Use subtle gradient borders (Tracing beam effect) to highlight.
sections_guidance.roadmap: A vertical timeline showing 'Features in Development' (e.g., 'Automated Email Dispatch', 'Cross-departmental API sync').
sections_guidance.testimonials: Marquee slider of avatars and comments like 'Reduced our SLA breaches by 84% in Q1.'
sections_guidance.dashboard_showcase: Large prominent screenshot of the actual product UI (use the provided dashboard_screenshots) wrapped in a glassmorphic frame with floating metrics.
sections_guidance.pricing: 3 tiers. Highlight the middle one with an electric cyan border and a glowing tag.
sections_guidance.faq: Accordion component for FAQs. Keep it sleek, 1px bottom borders.
sections_guidance.auth: Simple login/signup modal or dedicated section with glassmorphism over a dark grainy background.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure neon cyan text on dark background passes WCAG AA.
accessibility.motion: Use prefers-reduced-motion media query to disable heavy pulses.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='dept-water-btn', data-testid='run-demo-btn').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: No generic centered layouts. Use optical alignment and purposeful asymmetry.
Implement a noise/grain texture globally using a fixed SVG overlay.
Avoid purple-on-white gradients completely. Stick strictly to the neon cyan/void black palette.
Never use generic AI emojis (like bot face or brain). Use lucide-react icons.
Apply hover animations (translate-y, box-shadow) to all cards and buttons.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header. Use backdrop-blur with a semi-transparent background.
Do not apply `transition: all` globally. Apply specific transitions to interactive elements.
Always add `data-testid` to buttons, inputs, and clickable items.
